verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents webhook events, such as notices sent when an account is linked or a balance, ownership, or transaction refresh completes. These are developer building blocks that a developer must handle in their own code. There is no evidence of a user-definable rules engine that triggers actions automatically on events, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
